items.title: Is Nutanix Stock Really Cheap At 11x Earnings?
items.summary: Nutanix (NTNX) closed at $58.94 on Monday, Nov 16, which works out to 11.4 times its reported fiscal 2026 earnings of $5.17 a share. That looks like a bargain for a software company. It is not. About 79.6% of last year's reported profit came from a one-time $1.2 billion tax benefit, and once you take it out the stock trades at 56.7 times earnings.

items.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Tied To FAA Ground Stop After Router Failures Hit Flights
items.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) equipment was cited in an FAA nationwide ground stop that disrupted US flights on 16 November 2026. Preliminary FAA updates linked the outage to router failures in core networking infrastructure that supports air traffic control systems. Federal regulators and aviation operators began reviewing Cisco infrastructure contracts and redundancy practices used in critical air travel operations.
